title: Theme expert chat in Settings
body: Add a dedicated theme-expert chat inside Settings > Appearance, alongside the current editor and live preview. The user describes and refines a theme in multiple turns; show each validated proposal as a reversible preview, then Save & Apply through the existing user-theme flow. Accept structured Theme values only, without shell or arbitrary file edits. Offer Foreman-supported providers/models, defaulting to Codex with its configured default model unless the user chooses one. Start at docs/theme-system.md, docs/settings-menu.md, src/appearance.rs, src/theme.rs, src/config.rs.
